'''Vynock Squadron''' was a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Navy]]. It fought in the [[Battle of Corellia]] in [[3640 BBY]].<ref name="Eve of Destruction">{{TORcite|type=class|Imperial Agent|Eve of Destruction|Corellia}}</ref>
